headline:
لعبة Spirit Crossing
تصدر غدًا الاثنين
label: رسمي

angle.hook: Spirit Crossing, Spry Fox's cozy online game five years in the making, launches tomorrow on Switch 2, Switch and PC
angle.why_now: launch is Monday 16 Nov 2026, the day after the slot; the studio posted its roadmap through summer 2027 on 12 Nov
angle.what_it_means_here: Switch and Switch 2 pre-orders are open and the PC version is on Steam and Epic; no price on the pages read, Arabic support not listed in the pages read (Steam languages list has no Arabic)
angle.payoff: building a home, fishing tournaments, murals and shared spaces with friends, with demo progress carried into the full game
